howto: Pick Expeditions (18 boards with 3 lives), Classic (Easy, Normal or Hard) or the Daily board.
Tap a square to dig. Your first tap is always safe and opens an area.
A number counts the bombs touching that square, diagonals included.
Hold a square (or switch to Flag mode) to plant a flag on a bomb; tap a number whose bombs are all flagged to open the rest around it.
tips: A 1 with only one hidden neighbour: that neighbour is a bomb.
When a number already has all its bombs flagged, tap it to open the squares around it.
Compare two numbers side by side: the difference often proves a square safe.
Hint only uses the numbers and flags on the board, and glows the square it proves.
In Expeditions a bomb costs a life, not the game: finish with all 3 lives for three stars.

controls.keyboard: Tab, then the arrow keys pick a square, Enter digs, F flags. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap to dig, hold to flag (or switch the Dig/Flag button). Tap a number to open around it.

difficulty: Classic keeps the 9x9 board with 8, 10 or 16 bombs and one life. Expeditions grow from 7x7 to 9x9 with 5 to 18 bombs and 3 lives. The Daily board has 12 bombs and starts already opened.

cheats.effect: Safe path: five safe squares open for you
Mine radar: hidden mines show faintly
Extra life: the next mine you tap is flagged instead

features.hints: Hint (3 per board): proves a safe square or a bomb from the numbers and makes it glow; if nothing is certain it names the least risky square
features.undo: Undo (3 per board) takes back any dig or flag, even the bomb you just hit
features.level-select-or-daily: Expeditions: 3 worlds x 6 boards with 3 stars each; Classic Easy/Normal/Hard; and a Daily board that is the same for everyone each day
features.results: Cleared or Out-of-lives card with time, flags right, chords used, stars and XP
features.tutorial: First game: three coach notes teach digging, reading numbers and flagging; skippable, replayed from How to play
features.progression: 18 expedition boards x 3 stars (worlds open at 8 and 24 stars); XP levels unlock 6 ground looks (meadow, sandy shore, snowfield, crystal cave, jungle ruins, volcano); 3 daily goals and a weekly stamp chest
